subject: BlueWave: post-trial results recap and short endorsement invite
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@bluewave.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BlueWave: post-trial results recap and short endorsement invite

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for running the two-week evaluation with our LLM serving platform. The team saw the improvements we discussed, and I wanted to summarize the key outcomes and ask a small favor if you’re open to it.

Recap (two-week pilot, production-like traffic pattern):
- Mean 95th percentile latency: 210 ms (down from ~480 ms on your baseline service)
- Token cost per 1k: $1.85 (estimated, after batching and prefix cache) — ~38% lower than baseline
- Error rate (5xx) during peak windows: 0.2%
- Throughput: sustained 650 requests/min with headroom for short spikes

Files attached: bluewave-pilot-metrics.xlsx (raw metrics + charts), redwood-summary-3pager.pdf (short one-pager you can share internally).

Two asks:
1) If the results look right to you, would BlueWave be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence endorsement we can use in a short case study? I can draft a blurb for your review to make it quick.
2) If you’re comfortable, could we schedule a quick 15-minute call next week with you and 1–2 stakeholders so we can capture a few quotes and call out specific numbers for attribution?

Suggested times: Mon 11/23 10:00–10:30 PT or Tue 11/24 09:00–09:30 PT — happy to adjust.

Totally understand if procurement/legal need to sign off before anything public — we’ll run anything by your team first.

Thanks again for partnering with us on this pilot. Stephanie (cc) will handle any follow-ups on onboarding materials if you want to move to dedicated capacity.

Best,

Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.inference
(415) 555-0187

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. I walked the charts through our ops and data teams this morning; the latency and cost numbers line up with what we measured on our side. A couple small notes: the throughput numbers assume the same instance sizing we used in the test (we'll want to validate cost at slightly higher concurrency), and the cost estimate looks good when you include the batching savings.

We're happy to help with a short endorsement. Narrowing scope to 1–2 sentences and attribution of the latency/cost savings is fine — procurement will want to review any public quote, but they usually approve short blurbs.

I can do Tue 11/24 09:00 PT for a quick call with our infra lead (Katia Lopez) — that works for me. If you can draft a suggested blurb ahead of the call, that will save everyone's time.

Alex Morgan
Head of Platform Engineering
BlueWave Logistics

(617) 555-2234
